## T-CORE Clinical Stack
T-CORE utilizes a synergized clinical stack of 5 adaptogenic and bio-enhancing ingredients to optimize masculine biological rhythms:
- **Himalayan Shilajit Extract (500 mg)**: Mineral-rich adaptogenic resin that supports cellular energy, ATP synthesis, and foundational vigor.
- **Tongkat Ali Extract (300 mg)**: Traditionally selected to optimize active free testosterone release, stamina, and physical drive.
- **KSM-66® Ashwagandha (300 mg)**: Clinically verified adaptogen targeting cortisol balance, stress reduction, and muscular recovery.
- **Fenugreek Seed Extract (490 mg)**: Formulated to sustain confidence, metabolic function, and muscle definition support.
- **Piperine Black Pepper Extract (10 mg)**: Enhancer that increases the bioavailability and systemic absorption of the active compounds.

### Quality & Manufacturing Standards
All BIOMEN LABS products are manufactured in GMP-certified, ISO-accredited facilities, using vegetarian capsules, non-GMO components, and undergo rigorous heavy metal and purity testing.
